svg.text: NIT TIRUCHIRAPPALLI — CDI PACKAGED FOOD MANUFACTURING ERP
Complete Entity-Relationship (ER) Data Model — 15 Mongoose Schemas with Document References & Embedded Collections
ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN NOTES ON RELATIONSHIPS & CARDINALITIES:
1. DISPATCH IS AN ATOMIC EVENT: Dispatch is NOT a standalone collection. It is an atomic operational action on SalesOrder (dispatchedAt, status: 'Dispatched')
that decrements Product.currentStock, writes StockLedger (movementType: 'SALES_DISPATCH', direction: -1), and logs to AuditLog.
2. POLYMORPHIC DOUBLE-ENTRY STOCK LEDGER: StockLedger.item dynamically references RawMaterial, PackagingMaterial, or Product via Mongoose refPath.
3. DOCUMENT EMBEDDING: Line items in SalesOrder, Invoice, Purchase, and BOM are embedded subdocuments to ensure historic audit immutability.
